args.message: I added up each customer's order amounts, using all orders whatever their status, and counted customers per band. 201 customers have placed at least one order: 61 are under 1000, 68 are from 1000 to under 2000, 49 are from 2000 to under 3000, and 23 are at 3000 or more. 6 orders have no customer attached, so I left them out; counting them would wrongly add an extra "customer" to the under-1000 band. Every remaining customer ID matches a record in the customer list.
